$comment: The platform-authored seed set: twelve categories of eight, free to every account forever,
never sold, never removed. docs/ecosystem/23-tessera.md §2.6 and §7.2.
Its SIZE IS A COMMITMENT, not an estimate — §7.2 rests the whole no-pay-to-win argument on
"96 seed objects, free to every account forever, plus a free daily firing allowance. Nobody is
ever unable to build." A trimmed seed set would quietly convert that argument into a slogan.
`footprint` is a FIELD, not something the model is asked to infer (§2.6). A 1x1 object occupies
one 256x128 floor tile and is authored on 512x512 — three tiles of headroom, so a lamp-post
fits. A 2x2 uses the same canvas at half the depicted scale.
ONE canonical facing each. The second facing is a horizontal mirror applied at render time,
which is forced rather than lazy: micro-studio has no `seed` column (studio/src/migrations.ts
:154-252), and a pipeline that cannot fix a seed cannot render the same chair four times.
